question: Find \(x\) and \(y\) in the system \(\begin{cases}2x+3y=7\\3x-2y=4\end{cases}\).
solution: Multiply the first equation by 2: \(4x+6y=14\). Multiply the second equation by 3: \(9x-6y=12\). Adding gives \(13x=26\), so \(x=2\). Substitution gives \(y=1\).
